sources.support: BLS reports a May 2025 national median annual wage of $166,790 for marketing managers; this is an occupational benchmark, not a restoration-specific wage or hiring quote.

uses.section_heading: Match Capabilities and Backup to the Work
uses.article_quote: BLS reports a May 2025 national median annual wage of $166,790 for [marketing managers](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/management/advertising-promotions-and-marketing-managers.htm). All four figures above are national occupational wage context across employers, not restoration-specific salaries, local offers, total employment costs, or a requirement to hire four people. Do not add the medians together as the inevitable cost of an in-house option. Scope and actual candidates determine the work and pay to compare.

sources.support: BLS describes marketing manager duties including discussion of budgets and contracts, campaign planning, market research and directing staff.

uses.section_heading: Inventory the Work Before Choosing a Model
uses.article_quote: The [Bureau of Labor Statistics' marketing manager profile](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/management/advertising-promotions-and-marketing-managers.htm) describes work that includes discussing budgets and contracts, planning campaigns, researching markets, and directing staff. Use those functions to test a candidate's scope: a manager who coordinates specialists may not also have capacity to execute every technical task.

uses.section_heading: Compare the Same Scope and Period
uses.article_quote: The IRS explains that employers generally withhold employees' Social Security and Medicare taxes and pay an employer share; federal unemployment tax is reported and paid separately. Review its [employment-tax guidance](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/understanding-employment-taxes) with your adviser. Gross employee pay already includes employee withholding: do not add that withholding again as an employer expense. Estimate applicable employer-paid costs separately.

uses.article_quote: Calling a person a contractor does not settle their classification.
